macro.headline: Bull regime intact but momentum stalled; defensives lead while tech coils.
macro.story:
The tape is in a textbook transitional zone. SPY, QQQ, Dow, and Russell 2000 all sit above their 50- and 200-day SMAs with trends still pointed UP, and SPY is only 0.6% off its 52-week high — the structural bull regime is unambiguously intact. But under the hood, momentum has rolled over: MACD histograms are negative across every major index, SPY closed below the Bollinger mid-band, and the index just delivered a -2.55% 5-day pullback before Wednesday's snapback. This is what stalling momentum inside an uptrend looks like, not a breakdown.

The dominant cross-asset story, grounded in the active themes, is the AI Infrastructure capex cycle in its CHASING stage. Institutional capital has concentrated into mega-cap compute and infrastructure software while precious metals are getting unwound — gold -10% over 21 days, silver -24.5%, both with RSI in the mid-30s and trading below both SMAs. DXY at 99.8 with bullish MACD and trend UP is the validated headwind here: dollar strength is mechanically pressuring the metals complex. WTI down -15.87% in 21 days adds to the disinflationary cross-asset signal, which would normally be risk-on fuel — except the equity response has been defensive rotation, not broad chase.

The leadership tells the real story. Healthcare and Consumer Staples sit atop the sector momentum table with HOT status, RSIs in the high-50s/low-60s, and bullish MACDs — that is not what early-cycle leadership looks like. Technology and Communication Services, the AI-theme epicenter, are NEUTRAL-to-BEARISH on the sector scoreboard despite the named capex narrative, telling us the theme is concentrated in a handful of mega-caps rather than broad participation. The 10Y-2Y spread collapsed -28% over 21 days to just 0.333, VIX is at 19.03 (still above its 50- and 200-day SMAs with rising MACD), and VIX3M/VIX contango is flattening — credit and vol markets are pricing more uncertainty than the index price suggests.

Net read: Engine C is CALM (SPY above 200SMA, RSI 50.3, no washout active), and the bull regime grants the benefit of the doubt to longs in validated Early-Runway industries with confirmed continuation geometry. But macro confidence is LOW because price-above-SMAs is in genuine conflict with negative MACDs, elevated VIX, defensive sector leadership, and DXY strength. Position size accordingly and let the rotation radar — not the index tape — pick the hunting grounds.
